hypothesis: Return to the best-performing feature structure, but account for temporal padding in the boundary term. For this workload, padded temporal extent grows from three to six frames, whereas the original boundary feature assumed a fourfold increase.

pcvs.name: latent_volume
pcvs.rationale: Captures work proportional to the input spatial area.

pcvs.expression: x.shape[0] * x.shape[2] * x.shape[3] * x.shape[4] if feat_cache is not None and feat_cache[feat_idx[0]] is not None else 0
pcvs.name: cached_latent_volume
pcvs.rationale: Captures additional area-dependent work from cached temporal upsampling.

pcvs.expression: int(feat_cache is not None and feat_cache[feat_idx[0]] is not None)
pcvs.name: has_cached_features
pcvs.rationale: Captures the fixed overhead difference between initial and cached chunks.

pcvs.expression: x.shape[0] * (x.shape[3] + x.shape[4]) * (4 * x.shape[2] + 2 if feat_cache is not None and feat_cache[feat_idx[0]] is not None else x.shape[2] + 2)
pcvs.name: temporally_padded_boundary
pcvs.rationale: Models spatial boundary work using temporal extent including the two padding frames required by causal convolutions.
